name: field_under_butterfly_wings~held_ground^centred
architectural_reason: A field, not a block: five pavilions of unequal size stand apart on a shared ground and every roof folds inward as a butterfly, so the section repeats as a rhythm across the parcel and the ground between the pavilions is the public room. The organization has room to grow - the sizes, the spacing, the valleys and the ground they share are each a decision still open - which is what development is for. It is also a lineage no recent cycle has touched, unlike the compact and curved blocks.
